name: @attentionform/astra-mcp-server
description: Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for ASTra document IDE

tools.name: open_document
tools.description: Open a .docx document into an isolated session returning session ID and revision

tools.name: inspect_document
tools.description: Generate a Token-Optimized Outline Notation (TOON) outline and typography palette

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Literal substring search (default, case-insensitive) with opt-in regex via regex:true, returning matched element IDs and text previews

tools.name: execute_batch
tools.description: Execute an atomic batch of typed OOXML mutation operations with automatic rollback

tools.name: save_document
tools.description: Persist document session with mandatory OOXML schema validator gate

tools.name: close_document
tools.description: Evict document session from memory and release locks

tools.name: new_document
tools.description: Create a fresh .docx from a template and open it into a session

tools.name: compose_document
tools.description: Compile a Markdown string into operations via the execute_batch path

tools.name: export_document
tools.description: Export document to HTML, Markdown, or PDF format

tools.name: visual_inspect
tools.description: 2D spatial layout telemetry with optional headless rendered images

tools.name: get_document_history
tools.description: List saved git history for a session (newest first, read-only)

tools.name: preview_revert
tools.description: Read-only WOULD-restore preview for revert (never mutates)

tools.name: revert_document
tools.description: Restore an earlier saved state as a new head commit

tools.name: redo_document
tools.description: Re-apply the state undone by the last revert

tools.name: validate_document
tools.description: Preflight read-only OOXML schema audit for an active session

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Token-cheap document census returning word, paragraph, table, image, and page counts

tools.name: sanitize_document
tools.description: Scrub metadata, revision IDs, authors, comments, and PII from a document session

tools.name: normalize_document
tools.description: Canonical repair for an open session with schema sequence sorts and tag normalizations

tools.name: import_document
tools.description: Ingest an on-disk Markdown file into an open session under directory sandboxing

allowedDir.description: Absolute directory holding allowed .docx files. Manual step: copy this value into startCommand.config.args after --allowed-dir before install (this JSON file has no args interpolation; Smithery wires config via commandFunction in smithery.yaml, which this file does not use). Must be an absolute path.
